Now I have the definitive numbers:

```js
export const DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGETS = { minimal: 1024, low: 2048, medium: 8192, high: 16384 };
export function clampReasoning(effort) { return effort === "xhigh" || effort === "max" ? "high" : effort }
export function thinkingBudgetForLevel(level, custom) { budgets = {...DEFAULT, ...custom}; return budgets[clampReasoning(level)] }
```

So xhigh/max fall back to high's budget (16384) internally for the token-budget path; their distinct effect is the wire string (`reasoning_effort: xhigh|max`) sent when the protocol supports effort.
